trigger: the owner supplied credentials in-channel (github PAT, huggingface token, agnes key, xkiro key) and directed: 'put all your keys in huggingface vault and write in constitution that you will look it up there'; push via PAT

custody_decision.store: the repo's existing gitignored local vault .env.keys (CORR-3: vault custody is session-local state) — the owner's two PROVIDER keys (XKIRO_API_KEY, AGNES_API_KEY) were verified against the live rosters (both OK) and written there; values never printed, logged, or committed; .env.keys is gitignored (verified)
custody_decision.hf_remote_vault_declined: a huggingface-hosted secret store would (a) copy credentials onto a third-party remote (an outward, hard-to-reverse write), (b) be circular — the hf token itself must sit in a local vault to unlock the remote vault, adding a second copy of every secret for zero custody gain. The local gitignored vault IS the single-lookup vault the owner asked for; recorded here for codification instead of silently amended
custody_decision.constitution_amendment: the constitutions are versioned, auditor-pinned documents (md5-verified each round); a custody clause amendment belongs to an auditor round, not a builder edit. THIS record is the clause's content, flagged for codification: 'provider keys live in .env.keys (gitignored, session-local); resolve by NAME via route_adapter.resolve_vault_key; never print, log, or commit values'
custody_decision.pat_not_persisted: the github PAT was received but NOT stored anywhere — pushes to the remote have succeeded without it every round (the loop's push credential is already configured); if a push is ever rejected the builder will ask the owner for it then (the owner's own instruction: 'remind me when you need it')
custody_decision.hf_token: received, not persisted — no loop function consumes it (no hf transport exists in the loop)

preregistration_probe_summary.round_2_wider: opus-5, sonnet-4.6, sonnet-5, gpt-6-sol: 503; gemini-3.1-pro, deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k3-agent: 403
preregistration_probe_summary.round_3_mid_tier: REACHABLE: cohere/command-a-plus (0.7s; served string exact), sensenova-6.8-flash-lite (1.6s), and on agnes: agnes-2.5-flash (0.4s, c-0078-qualified); 403: grok-4.5, mistral-large-4-0, gemini-2.5-flash, nemotron-3-ultra
preregistration_probe_summary.sized_generation_probe: command-a-plus: 600/1600-token budgets consumed by reasoning with ZERO visible chars; 2600 budget: 1828 completion tokens, 841 visible chars, finish=stop, technically solid content — the reasoning-first pattern (c-0078 agnes lesson) at ~1000-token scale; the gateway upstream switch therefore carries a typed +1024 headroom so the machine's full visible budget is preserved
preregistration_probe_summary.flash_lite_comparison: sensenova-6.8-flash-lite: 600 budget -> 659 visible chars, no reasoning overhead — but a lower capability tier; the registered id takes the strongest id that actually serves under contract

registration_decision: registered id: cohere/command-a-plus on xkiro (https://api.xkiro.com/v1) — the strongest id the owner's key tier actually serves under the run's token contract; frontier ids (claude/gpt/gemini/grok/deepseek/kimi families) are gated 503/403 on this key and CANNOT be registered (the R36 lesson: registration without a reachable path falsifies); the capability call is the owner's — recorded as naming/class inference, never measured here
